recent_payoff_patterns: Put the object on the table. Let the reader do the math.
Give the body a physical task. The emotion takes care of itself.
Kill the observer filter. Let the danger strike the page.

recent_hooks: Never write about grief in the abstract.
This sentence says nervous. It doesn't make us feel it.
This sentence doesn't have an emergency. It has a reporter.
This dialogue tag doesn't add tension. It's apologizing for it.
This sentence says she was furious. It forgets to make her terrifying.
